Thanks for the heads up, Marissa.

Plan from legal side: 
- We will send a slim NDA template (one-way mutual optional) to internal.counsel@nimbushealth.com and cc procurement. Typical turnaround: 2-3 business days for standard NDAs if no commercial changes.
